note: Root-cause-matched guard restorations on the fixed-20 queue (analyst-specified). defihacklabs-rnspay-2025-03-06.root_cause: pay() calls a caller-supplied exchange target without checking the owner-managed allowlist `exchanges` (DeFiHackLabs: arbitrary external call abusing victim approvals)

defihacklabs-muredistribution-2026-05-21.root_cause: distribute() takes the signer from a caller-supplied pool source that is only checked for ERC-165 support; the restored check requires the repository (whose tokens move) to be a POOL_OPERATOR of that source, the rule moveDistribution already enforces through validManager (DeFiHackLabs: fake ERC-1271 signer)

defihacklabs-veth-2024-11-14.expected_revert: Ownable: caller is not the owner
defihacklabs-veth-2024-11-14.root_cause: a privileged factory function (0x6c0472da) that takes a vETH loan and adds liquidity is externally callable (DeFiHackLabs: privileged Factory function callable by anyone)

not_measurable.defihacklabs-silofinance-2025-06-25: the victim never executes and its harm is a debt position minted on its behalf, not an outflow; Eq. (1) gives no positive loss, so G_pos fails for every intervention
